title: Labor Records of Lagoon Amusement Park

communications.subject: Government Records Access and Management Act Request: Labor Records of Lagoon Amusement Park
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Government Records Access and Management Act, I hereby request the following records:

-All public records regarding any complaints, inquiries, investigations, citations, or final agency actions concerning alleged or confirmed labor law violations or labor standard violations by Lagoon Amusement Park (including registered corporate entities such as Lagoon Corporation, Inc.).
-Please include all investigative files, compliance reviews, correspondence between the Commission and the employer, witness or complainant statements (with required statutory redactions for personal privacy), and records of fines or corrective actions.
-I am requesting records from January 1st, 2024, through the date of this request.

This request is being made by a journalistic researcher. It is being made for research purposes, not commercial ones. Please assess fees in accordance with provisions for media requesters. In the event that this agency decides to charge this requester fees not to exceed the actual cost of reproducing the records, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request.

Please fulfill this request electronically, preferably by e-mail attachment, if available.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response within the statutorily-mandated timeframe.

Sincerely,

Lilly Hardy
